message.content: {"mechanism_id":"cr_memory_rank_reweighted_median","target_component":"M_CR memory update (weighted arithmetic mean)","observed_evidence":{"task_id":"TASK-02","trace_path":"diagnostic_trace_summary","function":"F10","seed":0,"metric":"CR_mean_late","observed_value":0.98},"causal_hypothesis":"Weighting by |delta_f| lets a few large-improvement trials with extreme CR dominate the mean, so M_CR ratchets toward whichever extreme yields occasional big gains, creating positive feedback.","algorithmic_change":"Replace the weighted arithmetic mean of successful CRs with a weighted median over the successful-CR buffer, using |delta_f| as weights; ties broken by lower CR.","mathematical_rule":"Given successful CRs c_1..c_k with weights w_i=|delta_f_i|, sort by c; M_CR = c_j where j = smallest index with sum_{i<=j} w_i >= 0.5 * sum_i w_i.","expected_effect":"M_CR stays near the bulk of successful CRs rather than chasing outliers, preventing monotone drift to 0.02 or 0.98 on F1/F6/F10/F20.","failure_prediction":"On unimodal separable functions where high CR genuinely dominates, median may lag and slow convergence slightly; on tiny buffers (k<3) median is noisy.","ablation_plan":"Compare weighted-median vs weighted-mean vs unweighted-median M_CR on 12 functions x 10 seeds; report CR_mean trajectory and final error.","nearest_known_methods":["L-SHADE weighted arithmetic mean M_CR","weighted median memory in jSO variants","trimmed-mean parameter adaptation"],"implementation_requirements":"Store successful CR list and |delta_f| per generation; compute weighted median at memory update; fallback to weighted mean if k<3; no extra RNG."}
